evidence: Matches the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies BaseIndex, txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, and txospenderindex across src/index/.
rationale: Decouples secondary indexes from internal node types (CBlockIndex, CChain, CChainState) and drops cs_main locking during sync and notifications. The PR also directly targets correctness during reorgs and initial sync, fixing an index startup race under -reindex-chainstate and eliminating stale index data returns during reorg windows.
